title: Gaussian noise stability
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real parameter $\\rho$, and a function $f:\\mathbb{R}^n\\to\\mathbb{R}$, its Gaussian noise stability is $\\displaystyle\\mathbb{E}[f(X)\\,T_\\rho f(X)]$, where $X$ has independent standard Gaussian coordinates and $T_\\rho f$ is the Gaussian noise operator with parameter $\\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on Fin n → ℝ
